title: 第9章 身体修复第10章 单兵测验
content_zh:
滴——
“074号单兵医疗舱，骨骼愈合度62%，达到最低作训标准。解除休眠，强制出舱。”
冰冷的机械合成音在第十七号浮陆底层医疗区回荡。
巨大的无菌舱室内，整齐排列着数百台圆柱形医疗舱。
昨日在无护具实战中被打断骨头、重创内脏的新兵，悉数浸泡其中。
空气中充斥着高浓度基础修复液的刺鼻气味。
在联邦军营，医疗资源从来不是用来让人痊愈的。
只要骨骼愈合达到百分之六十，能跑能动，主脑就会判定达标，强行将伤员踢出舱室。
“滴——112号，愈合度60%，强制出舱。”
“滴——209号，愈合度65%，强制出舱。”
伴随着接连不断的泄压声，上百台医疗舱的舱门滑开。三分之一的伤员被机械臂粗暴地推倒在冰冷的合金地板上。
压抑的闷哼与倒吸凉气的声音此起彼伏。
这百余名新兵拖着并未完全长好的断骨和隐隐作痛的内脏，艰难爬起。
而在他们身后，剩下的三分之二重伤员，则要继续在舱内虚度考核前最宝贵的时光。
扫描光束在舱室上方横扫，最终停留在角落的330号医疗舱。
主脑的运转指示灯罕见地闪烁了两下，发出一声短促的电子音。
“滴——330号医疗舱，愈合度75%，解除休眠，强制出舱。。”
休眠解除。
江岳睁开双眼。
他拔掉口鼻上的呼吸管，推开舱门，赤裸上身跨出医疗舱。

周围几名正捂着断肋痛苦穿衣的新兵下意识转头，目光扫过江岳的舱室，瞬间凝滞。
他们舱内的基础修复液，经过一夜的吸收，仅仅是绿色变淡。
而江岳舱内的液体，此刻已经彻底变成了透明的清水。
没有任何药力残留。所有的修复精华，被压榨得一干二净。
昨夜，在【安神】锁定脑波深度休眠、【顺气】平稳搬运体内气血的辅助下，新生的【韧皮】词条发挥了极其恐怖的拦截与转化作用。
新增的额外吸收率，将那些本该游离浪费的药效死死锁在皮肉骨骼之中。
江岳低头看了一眼自己的右肩。
昨日粉碎性骨折、几乎塌陷的部位，此刻肌肉饱满紧实。
除了表皮留下一道极浅的白色印记外，再无任何受创的痕迹。
他面无表情地抓起旁边机械台上叠放整齐的新作训服，套在身上，大步走向升降梯。
……
清晨，钢铁广场。
两万余名新兵正在集结。气氛沉闷且压抑。
经历过昨日的实战对练，每个人身上或多或少都带着青紫的瘀伤。
江岳走出升降梯，步入方阵，平静地站回了自己的位置。
在他左侧，李泰正龇牙咧嘴地揉着昨晚被人砸青的眼眶。
余光瞥见身旁多出一个人，李泰转过头，整个人如遭雷击，僵在原地。
“江……江岳？”
李泰活像见了鬼，声音甚至破了音，“你不是昨天被沈青把右边肩膀都打骨折了吗？！”
他下意识地伸出手，一把捏在江岳的右肩上。

入手传来坚硬感，显然是紧实的肌肉。
李泰猛地缩回手，眼珠子几乎瞪出眼眶。医疗区的规矩他懂，基础修复液绝不可能在一夜之间把粉碎性骨折彻底治愈。
江岳没有理会李泰的失态，目光直视前方，维持着【顺气】的呼吸节奏。
不远处，方阵的另一端。
content_en:
Drop——
"No. 074 individual medical cabin, the bone healing degree is 62%, reaching the minimum training standard. Release the dormancy and force the cabin to leave."
The cold mechanical synthesized sound echoed in the medical area at the bottom of Floating Continent No. 17.
In the huge sterile cabin, hundreds of cylindrical medical cabins are neatly arranged.
The recruits who had their bones broken and their internal organs severely damaged in actual combat without protective gear yesterday were all soaked in it.
The air is filled with the pungent smell of highly concentrated basic repair fluid.
In federal barracks, medical resources were never meant to heal people.
As long as the bone healing reaches 60% and the person can run and move, the mastermind will determine that the target is met and forcibly kick the injured person out of the cabin.
"Di—No. 112, healing rate 60%, forced to leave the cabin."
"Di—No. 209, healing rate 65%, forced to leave the cabin."
Along with the continuous sound of pressure release, the doors of hundreds of medical cabins slid open. One-third of the wounded were roughly pushed down to the cold alloy floor by the robotic arm.
Depressed groans and gasps came one after another.
These more than a hundred recruits struggled to get up, dragging their broken bones and aching internal organs that had not fully grown.
Behind them, the remaining two-thirds of the seriously injured people will continue to waste the most precious time in the cabin before the assessment.
The scanning beam swept across the cabin and finally stopped at the No. 330 medical cabin in the corner.
The main brain's operation indicator light flashed twice rarely, and made a short electronic sound.
"Drip—Medical cabin No. 330, healing rate 75%, release dormancy, forced exit."
Hibernation is released.
Jiang Yue opened his eyes.
He unplugged the breathing tube from his mouth and nose, pushed open the hatch, and stepped out of the medical cabin naked.
The few surrounding recruits who were holding their broken ribs and dressing in pain subconsciously turned their heads, their eyes swept across Jiang Yue's cabin, and they froze for a moment.
The basic repair fluid in their cabin only turned green after being absorbed overnight.
The liquid in Jiang Yue's cabin had now completely turned into transparent water.
No medicinal power remains. All the repairing essence has been squeezed out.
Last night, with the help of [Anshen] to lock the brain waves into deep sleep, and [Shunqi] to smoothly transport Qi and blood in the body, the new [Bast] entry played an extremely terrifying role in interception and transformation.
The newly added additional absorption rate locks the medicinal effects that should be free and wasted in the skin, flesh and bones.
Jiang Yue lowered his head and glanced at his right shoulder.
The muscles that were comminuted and almost collapsed yesterday are full and tight now.
Apart from a very light white mark left on the surface, there were no traces of trauma.
Expresslessly, he grabbed the new training uniforms that were neatly stacked on the machine table next to him, put them on, and strode towards the elevator.
…
Early morning, Steel Square.
More than 20,000 new soldiers are gathering. The atmosphere was dull and depressing.
After yesterday's actual combat training, everyone had more or less purple bruises on their bodies.
Jiang Yue walked out of the elevator, stepped into the square formation, and stood back to his position calmly.
On his left side, Li Taizheng grinned and rubbed his eye socket, which was bruised last night.
Out of the corner of his eye, he caught sight of an extra person beside him. Li Tai turned his head, and his whole body froze in place as if struck by lightning.
"Jiang...Jiang Yue?"
Li Taihuo felt as if he had seen a ghost, and his voice even broke, "Didn't you have your right shoulder broken by Shen Qing yesterday?!"
He subconsciously reached out his hand and pinched Jiang Yue's right shoulder.
There was a hard feeling in my hand, which was obviously a tight muscle.
Li Tai suddenly retracted his hand, his eyes almost popping out of his sockets. He knew the rules of the medical area. Basic repair fluid could never completely heal a comminuted fracture overnight.
Jiang Yue ignored Li Tai's gaffe and stared straight ahead, maintaining a smooth breathing rhythm.
Not far away, the other end of the phalanx.
